svg.title: Grounded isn't correct
svg.text: One grade, six parts, written down before the test.
facts, labels and stages come from the labelled questions
“HOW MUCH TIME OFF DO NEW DADS GET?”
the policy is gender-neutral: a dad who is the main carer gets 16 weeks
two of those are wrong: keep correct and grounded apart
grade the grader: 177 of 180 agree with a careful reading
the 3 misses: lists of table rows that include the right one
